## Composer Agent gateway

The composer's on-demand post critique (`critique`) and the planner's reword-this-idea call (`reviseIdea`). Both are AI acting on the WORDS of a post, which is why they share one gateway.

Vercel Hobby allows 12 Serverless Functions per deployment. The repo hit that ceiling, so these run beside n8n instead — see n8n/README.md.

The public Vercel proxy first verifies the signed-in browser; this workflow then forwards that same token to the private agent container, which enforces workspace membership.

Webhook path: `/arak-agent-composer`. Allowed body actions: `critique`, `reviseIdea`.
